en: A monochrome postcard reproducing a detailed historical painting of a ceremonial reception scene from the Council of Trent. The image shows cardinals and clergy in ornate vestments, nobles, soldiers, and townspeople gathered in an arcaded courtyard with Renaissance architecture in the background. The scene is framed by a large stone arch. Below the image there is Italian caption text in decorative fonts, with the title in red and additional description in black cursive, plus a blue handwritten signature on the right.
